scope: Default paper-backed comparison methods only; all are paper-derived adaptations, not official exact reproductions

dct_dm_qim_chen2001_blind.title: Quantization index modulation: a class of provably good methods for digital watermarking and information embedding
dct_dm_qim_chen2001_blind.authors: B. Chen and G. W. Wornell

dct_stdm_qim_chen2001_blind.title: Quantization index modulation: a class of provably good methods for digital watermarking and information embedding
dct_stdm_qim_chen2001_blind.authors: B. Chen and G. W. Wornell

dct_stdm_qim_chen2001_blind.adaptations: STDM-style spread-transform realization is a paper-inspired DCT-domain specialization; do not attribute every STDM design choice to Chen-Wornell 2001

dct_iss_malvar2003_blind.title: Improved Spread Spectrum: A New Modulation Technique for Robust Watermarking
dct_iss_malvar2003_blind.authors: H. S. Malvar and D. A. F. Florêncio

hessenberg_nha2023_blind.title: An effective embedding algorithm for blind image watermarking technique based on Hessenberg decomposition
hessenberg_nha2023_blind.authors: P. T. Nha, T. M. Thanh and N. T. Phong
hessenberg_nha2023_blind.paper_component: Hessenberg decomposition and quantization of designated entries
hessenberg_nha2023_blind.adaptations: 4096-bit payload common image benchmark adapter, possibly different from paper image format/strength

qwt_qsvd_zhang2022_blind.title: Robust image watermarking algorithm based on QWT and QSVD using 2D Chebyshev-Logistic map

dwt_qr_fa_guo2017_keyassisted.title: Optimised blind image watermarking method based on firefly algorithm in DWT-QR transform domain
dwt_qr_fa_guo2017_keyassisted.authors: Y. Guo, B.-Z. Li and N. Goel

dwt_qr_fa_guo2017_keyassisted.adaptations: Common mode uses YCbCr Y rather than original grayscale and default fixed lambda; the Firefly optimizer exists but is NOT invoked by common runner. Paper-inspired core implementation, NOT a full reproduction of FA parameter optimization
